svg.aria-label: Grid: Ducks: daily bag. All ducks together, a day: 8. Pintails, at most: 4. Canvasbacks, at most: 4. Goldeneyes, Barrow's and Common together: 2. Harlequins, at most: 2. Ducks in possession: 24.

g.data-tip: Two districts, one day|Hunt two districts in one day? The highest daily bag limit of all the areas applies (99%).
Inside the 8|Pintails, canvasbacks, goldeneyes and harlequins are restricted species. Their limits count inside the 8, never on top (99%).
g.text: The small limits count inside the 8

g.data-tip: 8 a day|8 ducks a day in every BC district (99%). A dead or wounded bird you find and keep counts in your daily bag (99%).
Pintails|No more than 4 Northern Pintails inside the 8 (99%).
Canvasbacks|No more than 4 Canvasbacks inside the 8 (99%).
Goldeneyes|No more than 2 Barrow's or Common Goldeneyes, in any combination, inside the 8 (99%).
Harlequins|No more than 2 Harlequin Ducks inside the 8 (99%).
Possession|24 ducks: 3 days' worth. Inside it: no more than 12 pintails, 12 canvasbacks, 6 goldeneyes and 6 harlequins (99%).
